stem_book: During a stunt, a cyclist (considered to be a particle) is undertaking horizontal circle inside a cylindrical well of radius 6.05 m. If the necessary friction coefficient is 0.5, mass of the artist is 50 kg. If she/he increases the speed by 20%, how much will the force (in N) of friction be? (Take g = 10 m/s².)
reason: Missing from manifest; static friction stays equal to the weight (g = 10 m/s² assumed, not printed) | stem: stated g = 10 m/s² (not printed, answer needs it)
work: Vertical equilibrium: f = mg = 50·10 = 500 N, independent of speed (only N grows)
